title: Docker: images, volumes, cleanup
question: How should images, volumes and cleanup look?

variants.label: Separate pages
variants.notes: Images, Volumes and Cleanup are separate pages in the sidebar. Each starts with the same disk bar (what Docker uses and what can be freed); images show which container uses them and if a newer tag exists.

variants.label: One Storage page
variants.notes: A single Storage page with the disk bar and tabs for Volumes, Images and Build cache. Volumes can be browsed in Files or backed up from the row.

variants.label: Cleanup checklist
variants.notes: Cleanup shows everything that can go, grouped (unused images, build cache, stopped containers, unused volumes) with checkboxes and the total you free. Volumes are never pre-selected. Can run every week.
